The Highlander Advantage

A Modern Precious-Metals Storefront

Highlander Gold & Silver operates as an ongoing online store rather than a standard auction. We don't force you into multi-day bidding wars against ticking clocks.

Instant Close On Request

Place an offer or check-out request on any item. HGS halts the online listing to close the sale directly for you, eliminating waiting days for an auction block to expire.

Numismatic Guarantee

Every coin is hand-picked for true luster and detail. If you present proof that a coin purchased was overpriced based on its market state, HGS refunds the difference or accepts the return.

In-House Insured Delivery

All packaging and fulfillment is performed in-house from our Bigfork armory. Every parcel ships via USPS Priority or Ground, fully insured with delivery confirmation.

Transparent 15% Premium

Flat 15% Buyer's Premium across all inventory with 0% Montana sales tax. Self-pay easily via PayPal with pre-calculated settlements, or wire credit on high-value lots.

Authentic Numismatic Promise

The Highlander Sold Value Guarantee

HGS spends numerous hours each week to hand-pick coins of high quality, regardless of the grading company's MS value printed on each slab. We evaluate coins for their true elements of luster, strike, eye appeal, and metal integrity.

Our Direct Promise: If at any time a customer proves that a coin they purchased was over-priced based on its current market state, HGS will refund the cost difference, or accept the return of the item at its full purchased value (as-sold). Buy with complete confidence knowing your investment is backed by genuine numismatic honor.

Delivery & Settlement Policies

1. Insured Domestic Shipping

All domestic shipments are fulfilled in-house via USPS Priority or Ground. Every parcel includes full insurance and postal tracking. Packages exceeding $500 require a signature upon delivery.

2. High-Dollar Wire Transfer Credit

For high-value bullion or gold coin acquisitions that exceed credit card limits, bank wire payment is accepted with an incoming wire fee credit applied directly to your settlement.

3. 24-Hour Settlement Window

Settlement is requested within 24 hours of invoice issuance. Prompt payments guarantee next-business-day dispatch from our Bigfork facility.

0% Montana State Sales Tax: All purchases processed through this Montana facility enjoy complete state sales tax exemption.
